rules.headings: Tracking tight (tracking-tight to tracking-tighter), NEVER use Inter for headings. Keep H1 max size to text-5xl or text-6xl. Use fluid scaling where possible.
rules.overline_labels: Uppercase, tiny text (text-xs), wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]), bold weight.
rules.numbers_and_data: Use JetBrains Mono for all pricing, estimations, quantities, and technical data.

colors.archetype: Luxury & Swiss High-Contrast Hybrid (Premium Construction + Tech)

rules.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for body text). When text is over images, use a dark gradient overlay or backdrop-blur with a dark tint.
rules.gradients: Do not use full-screen gradients. Use solid colors or very subtle radial glows (blur-3xl) behind key elements like the AI input field.
rules.borders: Use 1px subtle borders (border-border/40) to define sections. Avoid muddy grey backgrounds.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid surfaces with subtle 1px border. No soft, muddy shadows. Hover states should lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and add a crisp drop shadow.
surfaces.ai_elements: Use a subtle glowing outline or a 'Tracing Beam' effect on the AI prompt container to make it feel alive and intelligent.

visual_enhancers.radius: Minimal. Use rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px) maximum. Architecture requires sharp, precise corners.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a very subtle noise/grain texture over dark mode backgrounds to eliminate the 'digital flatness'.

components.strategy: Use Shadcn UI for all forms, tables, dropdowns, dialogs, and sliders. Heavily customize them to remove the 'default Vercel' look by applying the sharp radius and strict color palette.
components.ai_prompt_hero: A massive, centered input field on the hero section. High contrast, glowing border on focus, with a prominent 'Generate/Estimate' icon button inside.
components.trade_cards: Large bento-grid cards for categories (Renovation, Bathroom, Kitchen). Must include background images with a dark overlay and text anchored to the bottom-left.
components.budget_gauges: Use Recharts to build clean, minimalist circular progress rings or linear progress bars showing Budget vs Spent vs Predicted.
components.comparison_tables: Dense, data-heavy tables using Shadcn Table. Zebra-striping (bg-muted/30) on alternating rows for readability. JetBrains Mono for prices.
components.diy_guides: Step-by-step vertical timelines using a custom timeline component (left border with dots). Color-coded difficulty badges (Green: Easy, Yellow: Med, Orange: Hard, Red: Pro only).

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 to p-12 for section paddings. Inside cards, use p-6.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For the dashboard, use a High-Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-4 or gap-6. Make sure cards stretch (h-full).
grids_and_layouts.forms: Multi-step estimation wizard should have a clean, centered layout with a progress bar at the top.

motion.transitions: Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform duration-200). DO NOT use transition-all.
motion.hover_states: Buttons must have explicit hover text colors (e.g., hover:bg-orange-600 hover:text-white).
motion.page_load: Framer motion staggered entrance for dashboard widgets and trade category cards.

accessibility.focus: All inputs and buttons must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2.
accessibility.testing: MUST add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='ai-submit-btn', data-testid='category-card-bathroom').

media.icons: Use lucide-react for standard UI icons. Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone) for large, decorative trade category icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `yarn add framer-motion recharts lucide-react @phosphor-icons/react`.
Set up Tailwind config with the custom color palette (primary accent: #FF5A00) and fonts (Outfit, Manrope, JetBrains Mono).
Build the hybrid app structure: Public Marketing Landing Page -> Auth -> Dashboard / App.
The hero section MUST have the 'Smart Project' AI prompt prominently displayed above the fold.
Use Shadcn components for complex interactions but strip away the default rounded-xl borders to rounded-md for a sharper, architectural look.
Ensure dark mode is fully supported. Dark mode should use #0A0D14 for background and #131722 for surfaces, not pure black.
For the estimation wizard, make it a smooth multi-step form with progress indicators.
For data tables (materials, lots), ensure high contrast and use JetBrains Mono for all numeric values.
Ensure the DIY vs Pro comparator uses distinct visual cues (badges, color coding) to warn users about dangerous tasks.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (sharp corners or rounded-md) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing image categories = you will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
